The '''D'Astan sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the planet [[Nez Peron/Legends|Nez Peron]].

==History==
The sector was eventually ruled by the [[D'Asta family]]. By the time of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] return, it was governed by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Ragez D'Asta]]. He seceded from the [[Crimson Empire]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], following the dissolution of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Interim Council]].<ref name="CE2">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood]]''</ref> It returned to the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] after the [[Imperial Reunification]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> As the cost of returning the sector to the Empire, Baron D'Asta required [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] to consider a [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|truce]] with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="CE3" />

The sector was partially invaded by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] around [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] or earlier.<ref name="TEA" />
